title: 第409章 小花的心思
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

厉延霏双手抱胸，居高临下地看着小花：“我问你，林见微是不是怀孕了？”

小花被她盯地发毛，小声地回应：“是……是。”

厉延霏笑了一下，“你就不怕吗？”

“怕什么？”小花不明白她在说什么。

“你傻吗？当然是她有了自己的孩子后，就不会要你了啊。”

小花愣住了，低下头，昨晚那种害怕被抛弃的感觉又涌了上来。

厉延霏弯下腰，嘴角勾着一丝笑，“以前他们没孩子，接你回去不过是图个新鲜、解个闷罢了。现在人家马上要有自己的亲骨肉了，谁还顾得上你这个捡来的野种？”

“你等着瞧吧，现在才刚开始。等他们的孩子一出生，你就会过上以前在张家那种日子。说不定到时候他们嫌你多余，再把你送到福利院去。”

“你骗人！你说谎！”小花呼吸变得急促起来：“婶婶……姑姑才不会不要我！”

她想说婶婶不会不要她，可她心里又不确定。

厉延霏冷笑：“你姑姑？等她有了自己的亲侄女，你看她还顾不顾得上你。再说了，她连婚都没结，根本没资格领养你。”

小花眼眶一下子通红，小眼睛狠狠瞪着厉延霏，最后终于绷不住，“哇”地一声哭了出来。

“你就是骗人，他们才不会不要我……”

一旁的售货员见小花哭了，赶紧从柜台后面走出来，蹲下身，拿手帕给小花擦眼泪。

“你说你，跟一个小孩子说这些干嘛？”

厉延霏抱臂站着，“我只是让她提前认清现实。”

售货员叹了口气，转身在柜台后面拿了一颗水果糖，递到小花面前。

“小花，别哭了，吃颗糖，甜甜嘴。”

小花心里堵着气，猛地一甩手，水果糖掉落在地上。

她红着眼，带着哭腔喊了一句：“我才不稀罕你们的糖！”

喊完，抹着眼泪，转身就跑。

等着供销社外的小朋友见她跑出来，都跟着她一起跑，就怕晚了分不到零食。

小花不想让别人看到她哭，回过头，恶狠狠地吼：

“你们都不许跟着我！”

小朋友们都被小花这副模样吓到了，不敢再上前。

小花转身继续跑，穿过菜地，沿着那条熟悉的小路，一口气跑到了河边。

可这次，没人来找她了，也再没人给她烤鱼吃了。

李明亮叔叔回老家了。

小棠姑姑……现在应该已经在给那个没出生的孩子量布做小衣裳了吧。

“骗子，都是骗子……”

她嘴上反驳着，说姑姑不可能不要她，可真的不会吗？

Li Yanfei crossed her arms and looked at Xiaohua condescendingly: "Let me ask you, is Lin Jianwei pregnant?"

Xiaohua was stunned by her stare and responded in a low voice: "Yes...yes."

Li Yanfei smiled and said, "Aren't you afraid?"

"What are you afraid of?" Xiaohua didn't understand what she was talking about.

"Are you stupid? Of course she won't want you after she has her own child."

Xiaohua was stunned and lowered her head. The feeling of fear of being abandoned last night came back to her.

Li Yanfei bent down, with a smile on his lips, "They didn't have children before, so taking you back was just for fun and relief. Now that they are about to have their own flesh and blood, who can care about you, a picked-up bastard?"

"Just wait and see, it's just the beginning. Once their child is born, you will live the same life as before in the Zhang family. Maybe they will think you are redundant and send you to an orphanage."

"You're lying! You're lying!" Xiaohua's breathing became rapid: "Aunt... Aunt will never want me!"

She wanted to say that her aunt would not abandon her, but she was not sure.

Li Yanfei sneered: "Your aunt? When she has her own niece, you think she will not care about you. Besides, she is not even married, so she is not qualified to adopt you."

Xiaohua's eyes turned red all of a sudden, and she glared at Li Yanfei fiercely. Finally, she couldn't hold it any longer and cried "Wow".

"You're just lying, they won't let me go..."

When the salesperson on the side saw Xiaohua crying, she quickly walked out from behind the counter, squatted down, and wiped Xiaohua's tears with a handkerchief.

"Why are you telling this to a child?"

Li Yanfei stood with arms folded, "I just want her to recognize the reality in advance."

The salesperson sighed, turned around and took a fruit candy from behind the counter, and handed it to Xiaohua.

"Xiaohua, don't cry. Eat a candy and sweeten your mouth."

Xiaohua was filled with anger and shook her hand suddenly, causing the fruit candy to fall to the ground.

With red eyes, she shouted in a crying voice: "I don't care about your candy!"

After shouting, he wiped his tears, turned around and ran away.

When the children outside the supply and marketing cooperative saw her running out, they all ran with her, fearing that they would be late and not be able to share snacks.

Xiaohua didn't want others to see her cry, so she turned around and yelled viciously:

"None of you are allowed to follow me!"

The children were all frightened by Xiaohua's appearance and did not dare to come forward.

Xiaohua turned around and continued running, passing through the vegetable field, along the familiar path, and reached the river in one breath.

But this time, no one came to see her, and no one grilled fish for her.

Uncle Li Mingliang has returned to his hometown.

Aunt Xiaotang... should be measuring cloth to make clothes for the unborn child.

"Liars, they are all liars..."

She retorted, saying that it was impossible for her aunt to not want her, but was she really not?
